slides.texte_overlay:
21 things a man must do
for his father

1. Call him just to talk.
2. Ask about his father.
3. Learn his favorite song.

4. Let him teach you to fix
something, even if you know.
5. Fix something for him.
6. Borrow his tools. Return them.

7. Take him on a road trip.
8. Let him drive.
9. Listen to the old stories again.

10. Take him to dinner.
11. Pay before he notices.
12. Thank him in front of others.

13. Learn about the things he loves.
14. Share what you learn.
15. Ask his advice. Use it.
slides.texte_sophia:
13. Learn about the things he loves.
I use the Sophia app.
14. Share what you learn.
15. Ask his advice. Use it.

slides.texte_overlay:
16. Take photos with him.
17. Write down his recipes.
18. Record his voice.

19. Forgive him.
20. Become the man
he hoped you'd be.

21. Tell him you love him.
While he can hear it.
